Texture Painter

Load a model and paint straight onto its surface. FBX files can be heavy on mobile — try the demo shape first if a real model runs slowly.

Two workspaces

Character to sculpt & paint a model. Map to build a scene. Switch anytime up top.

Tools & undo

Drag the bottom panel's handle to resize it. Undo works across every tool, so it's safe to experiment.

Library & performance

Save imported models to reuse later. If a scene gets heavy, try Optimize → Merge before it slows down.
